name: Oculus
author: Andrew Gilley
description: Recognises the GitHub/Codeberg project or user open in your browser, shows whether oculus.nvim already tracks it, and tracks, opens or inspects it from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Open the panel on a GitHub/Codeberg page: it says whether you already track that project or user, and offers to track them, open their feeds, or inspect a PR, issue or commit.

schema.label: Tracking file
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/oculus/tracking.json; must match oculus.nvim's tracking_file.
